comments.note: api-client.js uses var for all declarations and classic function expressions rather than const/let and arrow functions. While consistent with the existing style (this is a browser-side vanilla JS file loaded without a bundler), a future modernisation pass could adopt ES module syntax once the project adds a bundler or targets only modern browsers.

The getRunLogEntries method builds its ?after= query string manually inline rather than delegating to buildQueryString (which already handles undefined/null omission). This inconsistency is minor but worth aligning — refactoring to use buildQueryString({ after: afterLine }) would remove the inline null-check ternary.
